answer: Each challenge is bound to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unpredictable until drand publication and cannot be biased by any single participant. A claimant must commit before the pulse, then derive and solve the revealed task, so a sybil swarm cannot precompute answer libraries, farm challenges offline, or selectively submit favorable identities. Whether labeled pearl, wharf, or haven, every claim faces fresh, publicly verifiable randomness.
